claims.statement: check-agents-structure.sh is a portable validator taking an optional target directory (default .agents) and scoping all checks to that tree; jq is optional — JSON is validated with jq empty when present and skipped with a warning when absent.

check-agents-structure.sh enforces a fixed required-file manifest (AGENTS.md, .gitignore, playbooks/README.md, sessions/README.md, aksk-bootstrap/docs-lint/learning-distill/task-closeout SKILL.md plus task-closeout example bundle files) and distinct sections for session tracking, skill frontmatter headers, and JSON validation.

Session tracking in check-agents-structure.sh is git-aware: inside a git worktree it asserts only sessions/README.md is tracked via git ls-files and reports ignored bundles via git status --ignored; outside git it warns and skips.

check-publish.sh is the release wrapper that cds to the git top-level, delegates structure to check-agents-structure.sh on root .agents only, and adds starter-repo-only hygiene: Remark formatting, markdown-link-check, published file list, leakage scans, and doubled-path hygiene.

Markdown checks in check-publish.sh use npx --no-install with timeout guards (15s package probe, 60s remark, 30s per file link check) and fail when violations are found; markdown-link-check is invoked with --alive 200,0 so offline status 0 does not fail external URLs.

Publish leakage scans (Bearer/sk-/ghp_/AWS keys/private keys/local paths) are warning-only, while the doubled .agents/.agents path hygiene check under README.md, INSTALL.md, docs and .agents hard-fails; the pattern requires a trailing path segment to avoid matching prose examples.

docs-lint is a procedure-and-checklist skill with no bundled executable script; its narrow mechanical pieces (doubled-path grep and frontmatter schema validation) can be run directly, while cross-tool wiring checks are performed by inspection by an agent or maintainer.

docs-lint reads root instruction files and their marker blocks (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md when present), .agents/AGENTS.md and playbooks, openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md and curated trees, and openspec/changes/archive/; it writes only reports and minimal edits to AKSK-owned files and never writes OpenWiki-owned indexes or run metadata.

Routing-block integrity verifies all three AGENTS.md zone families — AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE (vendored FerroxLabs baseline), OPENWIKI:START/END (presence only, never hand-edited), and AKSK:ROUTING/LIFECYCLE — each exactly once with intact markers and existing link targets; stale AKSK blocks are refreshed via attach_section.mjs reading markers from the template.

The AGENTS-BASELINE is vendored offline with a provenance header (source URL, capture date, license, refresh pointer); seeding never touches the network and the refresh path is opt-in, validated, and leaves the vendored baseline intact on offline failure, while docs-lint surfaces stale capture age as informational advice.

Wiki contract check requires openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md to carry AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers attached by attach_wiki_contract.mjs from wiki-contract-template.md; the script is append-only, idempotent/self-updating, exits 2 with openwiki --init when the file is missing, and never replaces OpenWiki-owned content.

Archived-change/wiki coverage pairing iterates openspec/changes/archive/*/ and requires descriptive outcomes to appear in openwiki/ or be exempted by a recorded deferral on the change's summary page; worked deferrals exist for 2026-08-23-aksk-openspec-bridge and the 2026-07-18 OBE batch.

Stale curated knowledge detection flags pages under openwiki/{decisions,troubleshooting}/ that reference retired skills, carry aksk_status accepted while aksk_superseded_by is set, or have dead aksk_depends_on targets; the triple-lock convention (aksk_status superseded authoritative, plus bold [SUPERSEDED]/[OBSOLETE] and strikethrough in listings) is verified here.

Content checks report but do not fail: duplication/contradictions between .agents/AGENTS.md, playbooks and wiki, oversized sections, broken relative links, curated frontmatter contract (filename stem identity, aksk_status, JSON Schema validation), and misplaced troubleshooting/decision pages; path hygiene shares the rg .agents/.agents pattern with check-publish.sh.

Index and log ownership is out of scope for lint: directory indexes are owned by deterministic sync_wiki_indexes.mjs (OpenWikiLocalShellBackend docsOnly/virtualMode via npm root -g), and .agents/docs/log.md was deleted; index drift is reported as informational guidance to rerun sync, not as a wiring failure.

All aksk-bootstrap scripts and both bash validators are offline-safe and fail-fast: peer-tool verification via check_peer_tools.mjs checks PATH only, prints per-tool errors with exact npm i -g install commands, rejects unknown tools, and never installs; optional tools (jq, rg, npx packages) degrade to warnings and timeout-bounded skips.

Staleness of the vendored FerroxLabs baseline is probed with refresh_agents_baseline.mjs --check which validates upstream without writing; a Captured date older than six months surfaces as informational advice, not a blocking failure, and the script leaves the vendored template byte-identical on network or validation failure.

Stale AKSK routing and lifecycle blocks are refreshed in place via attach_section.mjs which extracts markers from the template via markersOf() and replaces only the content between BEGIN/END, remaining idempotent when already current and never touching content outside markers.

Wiki contract drift on kit upgrade is repaired by rerunning attach_wiki_contract.mjs which detects the existing AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers and refreshes only the marked section from wiki-contract-template.md, remaining idempotent and append-only when absent.
